decision: No-marker constant superselection is a clean chain-rule theorem if constants are fixed representation data or quotient-owned.
Current MTS cannot claim b_alpha, b_mass, or b_clock vanish because no-extra-F2, no-mass-vertex, and no-clock-readout signatures are unsigned.
b_alpha, b_mu, b_mA, b_nuc, b_clock_i, and sensitivity rows are retained as nonclaim rows.
Next target should attack EM/Maxwell specifically: unique F^2 normalization and no f_X(X)F^2 counterterm, or b_alpha remains live.
